title: The dull label
explanation: The fix shows two finished labels and says not to copy them, so the assistant can match the pattern: a name, a colon, and three short words. Options A and C turn up the volume but never show the style.
brokenPrompt: Write a fun label for our new mango chutney.
brokenOutput: Mango Chutney. A delicious chutney made with mangoes and spices. Perfect with many dishes. Try it today!

diagnoses.text: Mango chutney is too hard a topic for the assistant.
It never showed what a fun label looks like, so the assistant guessed.

wrongDiagnosisHint: Think about the word 'fun'. Does the order show what it means?
rightDiagnosisNote: 'Fun' means different things to different people. With no sample, the assistant picked the most average kind of fun.

fixes.prompt: Write a fun label for our new mango chutney. Make it extra fun and exciting!
Write a fun label for our new mango chutney in the same style as these two. 'Bold Berry Jam: Sticky, sweet, spoon-ready.' 'Zesty Lime Pickle: Sharp, bright, bring bread.' Do not copy their wording.
Write a fun label for our new mango chutney. Use lots of exclamation marks and a joke.

wrongFixHint: That order still leaves 'fun' undefined. Pick the one that shows the style.
fixedOutput: Golden Mango Chutney: Tangy, sunny, scoop-it-up.
